title: 514-labs/dnsglobe
claim: 514-labs/dnsglobe — Global DNS propagation checker TUI — watch a DNS record propagate across 34 public resolvers worldwide, on a world map i
why_good: A clean TUI to watch DNS propagate across 34 global resolvers — a real, recurring devops annoyance, nicely scoped.
value: Hard to charge for a TUI; value is as a freemium tool with a hosted monitoring tier (alerts, history, team) like whatsmydns.
risk: Tiny scope, free web checkers exist (whatsmydns), easy to clone; more a beloved utility than a company.
pick_reason: The tool provides a specific solution for DNS monitoring that can be monetized through subscriptions or usage fees.

zh.claim: 514-labs/dnsglobe —— 全球 DNS 传播检查 TUI:在 34 个公共解析器上看一条 DNS 记录的传播。
zh.why_good: 一个干净的 TUI,在 34 个全球解析器上看 DNS 传播——真实、反复出现的 devops 烦恼,范围收得好。
zh.value: TUI 很难收费;价值在做免费增值工具 + 托管监控档(告警、历史、团队),像 whatsmydns。
zh.risk: 范围小、有免费网页工具(whatsmydns)、易被抄;更像受喜爱的工具而非公司。
